questions.stem: Why are alkali metals stored under oil?

options.text: To keep them shiny for display
To dissolve any impurities on the surface
To make them easier to cut
To prevent them from reacting with oxygen and moisture in the air

questions.explanation: Alkali metals are very reactive and would quickly react with oxygen (tarnishing) and water vapour in the air. Storing them under oil creates a barrier that prevents contact with air and moisture, keeping the metals unreacted.
